description: snowflake-arrow/1, synthetic (§9.8.2): result chunks written by tools/spec with pyarrow in the encoding ASSUMED until chunks are captured from Development (QUESTIONS.md, Q-SNOW-1): each chunk a complete Arrow IPC stream whose fields carry logicalType, precision and scale; FIXED with p <= 18 as the narrowest integer holding value x 10^s, p > 18 as Decimal128; REAL, TEXT, BOOLEAN, DATE as Float64, Utf8, Bool, Date32; TIMESTAMP_NTZ/LTZ as Int64 x 10^scale up to scale 7, else Struct{epoch, fraction}; TIMESTAMP_TZ as Struct{epoch scaled, timezone} up to scale 3, else Struct{epoch, fraction, timezone}, timezone being the offset in minutes + 1440. Each case gives the writer profile (its result schema and derived Arrow schema, §9.2.7), the source schema, the chunk files with their SHA-256, the handoff document that names them (first_chunk inline; links under https://results.conformance.test/, which the conformance gateway serves from its own storage), and the expected Atlas batches: one per chunk, as JSON rows (decimals as strings with exactly s digits, timestamps RFC 3339 UTC with six digits) and as an Arrow IPC stream. A chunk that does not decode into the writer's schema is invalid_document.
